flagged.evidence: The Definition calls T the basis of V, then says “Identify the Hermitian bispinor momentum matrix by T_{α dotβ}=σ^μ_{α dotβ}P_μ.” It describes P_μ as Hermitian physical momenta in a unitary representation but specifies no representation map ρ or whether P_μ are abstract algebra elements or represented operators. As written, the equation does not type-check between the abstract algebra basis and represented momenta. The historical claim that T itself must be τ-fixed is not justified: τ-fixed translations are combinations, not the basis elements T individually. The missing representation bridge remains.
